subject.title: fix(agents): time out stalled Claude live turns

question: Should Claude live sessions treat thinking/progress-only stdout as non-semantic progress on the existing noOutputTimeoutMs budget once the branch is refreshed?
rationale: The implementation is in the right runtime boundary, but source review cannot choose the user-facing availability tradeoff of aborting long reasoning-only Claude turns earlier than current behavior.

options.title: Refresh and prove the policy
options.body: Rebase onto current main, keep the semantic watchdog, and require focused exact-head proof that thinking-only stalls fail early while text, commentary, and tool construction still survive.

options.title: Accept the earlier abort behavior
options.body: Merge after conflict resolution if maintainers intentionally want reasoning/progress-only output to stop extending Claude live turns on the existing watchdog budget.

options.title: Tune before ready
options.body: Change the semantic watchdog budget or exemptions if maintainers want a longer grace period for legitimate reasoning-only Claude turns.

recommendation.title: Refresh and prove the policy
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current main, keep the semantic watchdog, and require focused exact-head proof that thinking-only stalls fail early while text, commentary, and tool construction still survive.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the PR and have recent adjacent agent/CLI history, so they are the best current owner for the draft timeout-policy choice.
